scope: Kangxi Wuying edition site page 445, second ancient-form glyph under 使 only

site_entry_record.interpretation: The site metadata maps the second K0000 form to U+20B46. It is retained as source evidence, not treated as the final project transcription.

initial_assessment.conclusion: Treat the SVG as U+20B46 and add that codepoint to guji-large.ttf.
why_superseded: It promoted site guwen metadata and a semantic-variant relation into a definitive glyph identity.
It used the absence of U+20B46 from the large font as part of an identity decision.
It did not give sufficient weight to U+21DEE, which is the closest existing large-font shape and has direct dictionary support as a variant of 使.

unicode_data.interpretation: The records establish separate encoded characters and a direct semantic-variant relationship between U+20B46 and 使. They do not establish universal interchangeability between U+20B46 and U+21DEE.

font_coverage.interpretation: The selected codepoint U+21DEE already exists in the large font and the plane2 fallback. No font modification is required.

shape_search.limitation: Shape ranking generates candidates and supports visual compatibility; it does not identify a character or resolve dictionary history.

decision.scope: page 445, second ancient form under 使
reasons: User literature research found direct dictionary support for U+21DEE as a variant of 使.
U+21DEE is visually compatible with the page SVG and ranks first in the existing large font.
U+21DEE and U+20B46 remain distinct Unicode characters with different properties and dictionary paths.
The production large font already maps U+21DEE.

historical_snapshot_note.policy: Preserve as evidence for the earlier scan-blank task; do not treat it as the current transcription.

writes_performed.annotation: The annotation had already been updated to U+21DEE during the decision turn; this audit documents that state.
